headlines.title: Airbnb owners hit by £800m tax raid
headlines.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Airbnb owners will be hit by John Healey’s Budget tax raid on landlords, piling yet more pressure on Britain’s tourism industry.

headlines.title: Airbnb hosts threaten boycott and higher cleaning fees over new guest chore policy
headlines.summary: Airbnb’s new house rules policy, which takes effect on Nov. 20, has been met with pushback from hosts with some threatening to leave the platform or raise fees. Hosts cannot make guests “complete tasks that require significant effort or time, or would typically be performed by a cleaner.” The change targets one of guests’ most persistent complaints about the platform: paying a cleaning fee and being handed a chore list anyway.

headlines.title: Airbnb’s next big bet: 1 million free nights a year for people in crisis
headlines.summary: CEO Brian Chesky explains why he’s committing $500 million over five years to dramatically expand its nonprofit’s housing efforts.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
